s1 = winsorize(ts_backfill({special_items_score}, 63), std=4)
s2 = winsorize(ts_backfill({accrued_expenses_score}, 63), std=4)
s3 = winsorize(ts_backfill({revenue_recognition_score}, 63), std=4)
s4 = winsorize(ts_backfill({deferred_rev_score}, 63), std=4)
s1z = group_zscore(s1, industry)
s2z = group_zscore(s2, industry)
s3z = group_zscore(s3, industry)
s4z = group_zscore(s4, industry)
main = divide(add(add(add(s1z, s2z), s3z), s4z), 4)
int12 = multiply(s1z, s2z)
int13 = multiply(s1z, s3z)
int24 = multiply(s2z, s4z)
int34 = multiply(s3z, s4z)
interaction = divide(add(add(add(int12, int13), int24), int34), 4)
combined = subtract(main, multiply(0.5, interaction))
signal = group_zscore(combined, industry)
idea: 非线性欺诈三角交互：在组内标准化基础上，不仅计算四维度简单平均（主效应），更构造关键维度的两两交互项（如特殊项目×收入确认、应计×递延收入）。当多维度同时恶化时（交互项为正），风险呈非线性放大，通过惩罚交互项捕捉"欺诈三角"的协同效应。
